description: Advisory indicators for agricultural loan review. Thresholds are illustrative for a synthetic POC and must be calibrated by the lending institution before any real use.

required_documents.farm_business_plan: Farm business plan or cooperative production plan
required_documents.yield_or_sales_evidence: Evidence of past yields or sales (receipts, cooperative delivery records)
required_documents.land_use_evidence: Evidence of land use or tenancy for the cultivated area
